text:
maria: noticing p99 jitter for small tenants. idea: add an admission gate that returns ADMIT_FASTPATH | ADMIT_WARMUP | DEFER_TO_BATCHER. gate only decides.
kevin: agreed. keep decision enum + reason tag. inputs: token_count, deadline_hint, tenant_credits.
jamal: careful about KV warmup impact. warmup lane should intentionally pick some mid-size requests to warm cache.
erin: ops: if fastpath pool >75% util, auto-downgrade to DEFER_TO_BATCHER and emit alert.
ops-bot: alert: fastpath_util=78% on pool-x - suggest scale or reduce credits.
maria: rollout: sim-mode (emit "would_fastpath" metrics) 48h, then 1% per-box -> 10% ramp. A/B canary tenants + router kill-switch.
kevin: add per-decision counters and reason labels (over_rate, deadline_ok, kv_candidate).
jamal: tests: replay a week of traffic into sim-mode to check KV-hit delta and tail effects.
maria: i'll draft RFC with enums, proto, metrics, and sim results by EOD Friday. thanks.
